import sys,json,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont
import mesa_canvas_probe as gl
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1];OLD=P
old=gl.program(P/'tests/fixtures/ascii_post_v0_9_1.gdshader.txt');new=gl.program(P/'shaders/ascii_post.gdshader')
def img(p):return np.asarray(Image.open(p).convert('RGB'),dtype=np.float32)/255
oldatlas=img(OLD/'assets/ascii_atlas.png')
settings=dict(exposure=1.,glyph_gain=1.4,edge_gain=.45,bloom_strength=0.,readability=.65,background_calm=.4,color_saturation=.68,surface_fill=.50)
legacy=dict(exposure=1.216,glyph_gain=1.78,edge_gain=.9,bloom_strength=0.,readability=.98,background_calm=1.,color_saturation=.85)
checks=[]
for w in range(4,11):
 h=int(w*1.5+.5);atlas=img(P/f'assets/ascii_prefiltered/glyphs_{w}.png');coverage=img(P/f'assets/ascii_prefiltered/coverage_{w}.png')
 previous=-1
 for value in [0,.005,.01,.02,.05,.1,.2,.4,.7,.9]:
  source=np.full((h*20,w*28,3),value,dtype=np.float32)
  result=gl.render(new,source,atlas,coverage,cell_px=w,**settings)
  mean=result[:,:,:3].mean(dtype=np.float64)
  toe=np.clip(value/.012,0,1);toe=toe**2*(3-2*toe)
  expected=np.clip(((1-.65)*value+.65*(value**.78)*.92)*toe,0,.94)
  assert abs(mean-expected)<.0001,(w,value,mean,expected)
  assert mean>=previous-1e-5,(w,value,previous,mean)
  assert np.isfinite(result).all() and result.min()>=0 and result.max()<=1.001
  previous=mean
  checks.append(dict(width=w,input=value,output=float(mean),expected=float(expected)))
# Changes to contrast/fill must not turn a surface darker overall.
for calm in [0,.4,1]:
 for fill in [.15,.34,.55]:
  for gain in [1.,1.4,2.2]:
   source=np.full((9*20,6*28,3),.2,dtype=np.float32)
   params={**settings,'background_calm':calm,'surface_fill':fill,'glyph_gain':gain}
   result=gl.render(new,source,img(P/'assets/ascii_prefiltered/glyphs_6.png'),img(P/'assets/ascii_prefiltered/coverage_6.png'),cell_px=6,**params)
   expected=(1-.65)*.2+.65*(.2**.78)*.92
   assert abs(result[:,:,:3].mean(dtype=np.float64)-expected)<.0001
legacy_cases=[]
for val in [.1,.2]:
 src=np.full((120,160,3),val,dtype=np.float32)
 r=gl.render(old,src,oldatlas,cell_px=4,**legacy)
 legacy_cases.append(float(r[:,:,:3].mean(dtype=np.float64)))
assert legacy_cases[1]<legacy_cases[0],legacy_cases
print('Legacy .1/.2 test outputs:',legacy_cases)
print('70 tone/width + 27 contrast-invariance tests: PASS')
info={'driver':gl.getstr(0x1F01).decode(),'gl_version':gl.getstr(0x1F02).decode(),'scope':'GLSL translation of actual canvas fragment via Mesa software EGL; NOT Godot runtime / parser / GPU integration','tone_tests':checks,'contrast_invariance_cases':27,'legacy_brightness_reversal':{'input':[.1,.2],'output':legacy_cases},'all_passed':True}
(P/'build/mesa_probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(info,indent=2))
